'''Escape From The Mystery Forest!''' (Japanese: '''謎の森をぬけだせ!!''' ''Escape From The Mysterious Forest!!'') is the fifteenth chapter of the [[Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys]] manga.

==Plot==
On his way to [[Olivine City]], {{GnB|Gold}} gets lost in a misty forest. He encounters a wild {{p|Dugtrio}}, but before he can attack it, a girl appears and starts battling it with her {{p|Cyndaquil}}. She loses and the Dugtrio escapes. Afterwards, she introduces herself as {{GnB|Chris}}, a "Pokémon Adventurer".

As they are both lost, Gold sends has his {{p|Pidgeotto}} use {{m|Gust}} to clear the mist, revealing a cavern ahead. However, Chris is then chased out by an {{p|Ursaring}}, causing the two of them to run even deeper into the forest. Chris then sends out her {{p|Hoothoot}} as a lookout, who finds some ruins on top of a hill in a clearing. Chris wants to explore, but Gold decides to leave. Gold feels guilty about leaving her behind, however, so he goes back, only to find her being chased by Ursaring again. Gold and Chris combine their Pokémon's powers to defeat Ursaring, allowing them to escape.

After their victory, the mist clears, with {{p|Suicune}} appearing in the distance. It leaves, with the mist and the ruins disappearing with it.

==Major events==
* {{GnB|Gold}} meets {{GnB|Chris}} for the first time.
